name: [🔥] The RakOOF
desc:
This noob won't stop attacking people! Be quick and find a place to hide before the night starts. Get points for surviving and buy tools. How many nights will you survive?
The RakOOF is a rounds-based game where you run and hide from one of the smartest AIs in Roblox!

This is a fan-made game of: https://www.roblox.com/games/2413927524/

Only 1k Points will save!

Controls:
Run - Shift / B Button / L2 Trigger
NightVision - N / DPad Down (Need night vision tool)
Shift Lock - T / Y Button
Emotes - G / DPad Right
